# sdmhelpers

`sdmhelpers` provides helper functions for species distribution
modelling with `maxnet` workflows, extending target-group aproach with
phenological weighting, temporal overlap estimation, and raster-based
kernel density estimation. Furthermore this package includes
functionality for independent spatial-fold selection and model
evaluation with validation TSS.

`sdmhelpers` was developed in project “HiQBioDiv: High-resolution
quantification of biodiversity for conservation and management” funded
by the Latvian Council of Science (Ref. No. VPP-VARAM-DABA-2024/1-0002).

## Installation

You can install the development version of `sdmhelpers` from GitHub
with:

``` r

# install.packages("pak")
pak::pak("aavotins/sdmhelpers")
```

Alternatively:

``` r

# install.packages("remotes")
remotes::install_github("aavotins/sdmhelpers")
```

## Available functions

The package currently includes:

- [`doy_kde_weights()`](https://aavotins.github.io/sdmhelpers/reference/doy_kde_weights.md)
  for seasonal phenological weights calculated for day of inventory or
  trapping as compared to species (registration) activity;

- [`torus_overlap_many()`](https://aavotins.github.io/sdmhelpers/reference/torus_overlap_many.md)
  for seasonal and diel overlap between reference species and possibly
  many other species;

- [`select_folds_by_quota()`](https://aavotins.github.io/sdmhelpers/reference/select_folds_by_quota.md)
  for selecting presences as complete fold groups;

- [`select_joint_folds()`](https://aavotins.github.io/sdmhelpers/reference/select_joint_folds.md)
  for coordinated presence and background selection as complete fold
  groups;

- [`max_tss()`](https://aavotins.github.io/sdmhelpers/reference/max_tss.md)
  for finding the maximum true skill statistic;

- [`tss_user_eval()`](https://aavotins.github.io/sdmhelpers/reference/tss_user_eval.md)
  for use with ENMeval user-defined evaluation;

- [`sfKDEterraff()`](https://aavotins.github.io/sdmhelpers/reference/sfKDEterraff.md)
  for fast raster-based Gaussian kernel density estimation, used to
  create bias layer, based on (seasonally) weighted or unweighted
  locations.

## Example

``` r

library(sdmhelpers)

max_tss(
  p_pos = c(0.71, 0.82, 0.91),
  p_neg = c(0.12, 0.23, 0.34)
)
```

# Package index

## Phenology and temporal overlap

- [`doy_kde_weights()`](https://aavotins.github.io/sdmhelpers/reference/doy_kde_weights.md)
  : Calculate Day-of-Year Phenology Weights Using Circular Kernel
  Density
- [`torus_overlap_many()`](https://aavotins.github.io/sdmhelpers/reference/torus_overlap_many.md)
  : Estimate Seasonal and Daily Activity Overlap on a Torus

## Spatial fold selection

- [`select_folds_by_quota()`](https://aavotins.github.io/sdmhelpers/reference/select_folds_by_quota.md)
  : Select Complete Fold Groups to Approximate a Target Sample
  Proportion
- [`select_joint_folds()`](https://aavotins.github.io/sdmhelpers/reference/select_joint_folds.md)
  : Select joint presence and background folds for independent testing

## Model evaluation

- [`max_tss()`](https://aavotins.github.io/sdmhelpers/reference/max_tss.md)
  : Calculate the Maximum True Skill Statistic
- [`tss_user_eval()`](https://aavotins.github.io/sdmhelpers/reference/tss_user_eval.md)
  : Calculate TSS Statistics During ENMeval Evaluation

## Spatial kernel density estimation

- [`sfKDEterraff()`](https://aavotins.github.io/sdmhelpers/reference/sfKDEterraff.md)
  : Fast Gaussian KDE from sf POINT geometries

## Example observations

- [`aves_large`](https://aavotins.github.io/sdmhelpers/reference/aves_large.md)
  : Large (species-wise) example bird-observation dataset
- [`aves_small`](https://aavotins.github.io/sdmhelpers/reference/aves_small.md)
  : Small (species-wise) example bird-observation dataset
- [`amphibia_dates`](https://aavotins.github.io/sdmhelpers/reference/amphibia_dates.md)
  : Example amphibian observations with dates
- [`bryophyta_all`](https://aavotins.github.io/sdmhelpers/reference/bryophyta_all.md)
  : Example bryophyte observations
- [`bryophyta_one`](https://aavotins.github.io/sdmhelpers/reference/bryophyta_one.md)
  : Example observations for one bryophyte taxon
- [`habitat_inventories`](https://aavotins.github.io/sdmhelpers/reference/habitat_inventories.md)
  : Example habitat inventories

## Example spatial data

- [`example_presences`](https://aavotins.github.io/sdmhelpers/reference/example_presences.md)
  : Example species-presence locations
- [`example_background`](https://aavotins.github.io/sdmhelpers/reference/example_background.md)
  : Example background locations
- [`example_grid`](https://aavotins.github.io/sdmhelpers/reference/example_grid.md)
  : Example raster-grid geometry
- [`example_egv`](https://aavotins.github.io/sdmhelpers/reference/example_egv.md)
  : Example ecogeographical-variable raster
- [`example_independent_blocks`](https://aavotins.github.io/sdmhelpers/reference/example_independent_blocks.md)
  : Example independent spatial blocks
- [`points100`](https://aavotins.github.io/sdmhelpers/reference/points100.md)
  : Example 100-m grid points
- [`egv_names`](https://aavotins.github.io/sdmhelpers/reference/egv_names.md)
  : Names of example ecogeographical variables
